brief: Create a responsive Korean product page for Karrot that helps a resident understand and enter the neighborhood marketplace. Keep the product facts and interface tokens within the supplied reference evidence; make the information useful rather than turning the page into a brand audit.
fact_boundaries: Do not invent user counts, transaction counts, rankings, testimonials, fees, guarantees, safety outcomes, or availability by location.
Pretendard is reference narrative only; it is not authorized as the rendered UI family. Use a system font stack without labeling it Pretendard.
Do not merge the product semantic primary and marketing CTA colors into one claimed token.
deterministic_acceptance: A runnable Korean-language page loads without uncaught console errors.
Every numeric, color, company, and product claim is either in locked_facts or omitted.
The primary marketplace call to action is keyboard reachable and leads to a deterministic local destination or state.
Interactive category controls expose selected and focus states and do not conceal content when JavaScript initializes.
At 390x844 and 1440x900 the page has no horizontal document overflow.
Automated checks reject rendered claims that Pretendard is the active UI font.
